# Map of Fire

> > A mobile mapping application providing real-time fire and disaster tracking with advanced geospatial visualization.

Map of Fire is an Android-based mapping platform built on Mapbox that delivers critical fire and emergency information to users. The application leverages modern Android development tools and weather data from NDFD to provide timely situational awareness.

- Map of Fire

- Mapbox
